system.description:
Only Set and Set's own childer can perform this terrifying power, becoming a giant serpent of fluid, glittering darkness in the shape of Set's defeated enemy, Apep. In this form, physical force cannot harm the vampire: no claws, fangs, bullets or explosions, only fire, sunlight or magic. Physical barriers cannot easily stop the vampire, whose shadowy form can seep through even the tiniest crack, yet she can still exert physical and supernatural force freely.

You spend a Willpower Trait; the transformation takes three turns to complete and lasts a full scene. You gain six Physical Traits and become immune to all forms of damage except fire, sunlight and magic.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.prerequisites: Only Set and his direct childer may learn this power
